classification.difficultyReason: Match corresponding sides of similar pentagons shown in different orientations and apply the scale factor.

content.prompt: Two similar figures are shown. What is the value of $x$?

spec.description: Two unshaded similar pentagons in differing orientations, retaining all six printed side labels and both right-angle marks. The larger figure is a rotated enlargement of the smaller figure.
spec.mathematics: The short sides 2 cm and 3 cm correspond, as do 6 cm and 9 cm; the 12 cm side corresponds to x cm. Coordinates describe the schematic appearance, not additional numerical givens.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and x appear; the answer is withheld.

answer.worked:
The corresponding short sides give the scale factor $\dfrac{3}{2}$.
$$\begin{align*}x&=12\times\frac{3}{2}\\x&=18\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
